body.en: Wavewalker was badly damaged and water was pouring in. The narrator stretched canvas and waterproof hatch covers across the gaping holes so that most of the water would run off. Larry and Herb pumped water out for hours without stopping or complaining, while Mary kept the boat on course at the wheel. When the electric pump failed, the narrator found and rigged up a spare pump, and slowly they began to gain on the water.

body.en: Sue had a large bump on her head and badly swollen eyes, but she had not complained because she did not want to worry her busy parents. Jonathan, asked if he was afraid, answered calmly that they were not afraid to die if they could all be together, which gives the account its title. Later Sue drew a card with funny pictures of her parents to cheer them up.

problem.en: How did the two children show courage during the crisis?

steps.en: Sue hid a serious head injury so her parents would not be distracted.
Jonathan stayed calm and said they were not afraid if they were together.
Sue later made a card to lift her parents' spirits.

answer.en: Sue bore a painful head injury in silence so that her parents could focus on saving the boat, and later cheered them with a funny card. Jonathan faced death calmly, saying that he was not afraid as long as the family was together.
